verdict_55_GBps.why: Every mechanism tops out at 41-45 GB/s on this link (65-71% of the 63.0 GB/s raw x16 Gen5 rate): copy engine 40.8 (prior 47-49), TMA 43.4 (44.96 best rep), plain loads lower. More concurrency lowers throughput (4 streams, >= 35 CTAs, > 1 MiB in flight), so the limit is the host-side read path (root complex / host memory / WSL2 GPU-PV address translation), not bytes in flight. HYPOTHESIS, not measured: 55+ needs a platform change (native Linux instead of WSL2, PCIe MPS/MRRS settings), which the rules do not allow us to touch.
verdict_55_GBps.headroom_for_gather_transport: <= ~5% (42 -> 44-45 GB/s); a gather retune is not worth a new prebuilt

plan_tomorrow.name: Overlap (a): gather on a side stream parallel to the shared expert, exact
plan_tomorrow.what: Qwen3_5MoE decode: router GEMV -> top-k -> lru_ensure -> fork(event) gather on a side stream -> shared expert + gate on the main stream -> join -> marlin. Same kernels, same inputs, only order/streams change; window ~17-21 us per layer with misses (f1 trace: router+shared block 21 us median) x 17.6-19.5 such layers/step -> est. 0.30-0.35 ms/step = +4% decode at 16K, +3% at 120K. No new kernel -> no recipe-digest change, no prebuilt.

plan_tomorrow.name: Speculation feasibility: route trace + recall
plan_tomorrow.what: Option (b) previous-token routing and (c) staging of the previous token's misses predict 0% of misses by construction (those experts are the most recently used and LRU never evicts them within one step: 3164 slots vs 320 uses/step) - confirm on the trace. Real candidate: pre-gating (router L+1 applied to the residual at the start of layer L+1, or to layer L's MoE input). Offline LLM eager trace on a copy (3 prompts x 256 tokens, 16K + 120K) recording actual top-8, LRU misses and predictions; exact LRU replay with/without prefetch for miss coverage, wasted bytes and pollution.

plan_tomorrow.name: Pre-gating prefetch prototype (only if miss coverage >= ~0.6)
plan_tomorrow.what: side-stream plan+gather after layer L+1's input norm (no GEMM in flight -> no slot protection needed beyond the step's stamped slots), join before ensure(L+1); bytes in slots always equal the host rows, so outputs stay byte-identical; window = mixer of L+1 (~65 us GDN at 16K, ~350 us attention at 120K). Reuse work/cuda-decode-prefetch protocol, .shared::cta TMA kernel.
